Robo Lac Loi models (RoboBall, EnergyCore, core_icon, support crystals, shield_icon) were made for this project with Tools/blender/*.py.
Robo Lac Loi sounds (Audio/*.wav: SFX, ambience beds, Ending charge/ignition/engine) were synthesized for this project with Tools/audio/make_sfx.py (no samples from other sources).
Robo Lac Loi challenge assets (hazard meshes/materials, planet texture, rim shader, and UI/minimap icons) are generated for this project by the bundled Tools and Assets/Editor/ChallengeAssetSetup.cs.
nang_luong.mp3 (energy pickup) and game_music.mp3 (menu/level music) were provided by the team for this project.
